properties.name: WHAT WORKED (dev_storyflow, 2026-09-24 and 2026-09-27): the root-cause skill's "the observation itself may be wrong" candidate changed an outcome, and step ② (search the raw words first) twice found the record that settled it
properties.statement: Recorded so a regression is checkable. 09-24 (session 3bd108ab): the finding to fix ("onboarding writes a blob the sheet never reads") was true in code but never observed — a census showed 0 of 1,182 characters had ever received onboarding spells, because onboarding's only screen is mounted nowhere; "Fixing the stated cause alone would have changed nothing a player sees. The `search_design`-on-the-raw-string step found the TemporalFact that originally made the claim, which is how I learned it was inferred, not seen." 09-27 evening (on flo2.io): "Root-cause step ② paid off immediately. One of four defects … had been root-caused on 09-26 as an instance of a recorded 137-call class. Reading that saved a re-diagnosis. It also exposed that my own step-⑥ claim … was stale, because the gate had been fixed on 09-26." What must not regress: step ②'s raw-words search and step ③'s mandatory "the observation itself is wrong" candidate.
